Reported composition, also unconfirmed: 75 sites made up of 53 drive-up tent, 12 RV with full hookups (30 amp), 10 hike-in tent and 1 developed group site, plus hot showers, a dump station, an amphitheatre and seasonal campfire programs. Every fact in this row comes from web-search summaries of the park's camping page rather than the page itself, which this environment cannot reach; fee and check-in times were left blank rather than guessed. Note the 10 hike-in sites mean access_mode is not uniform across the campground -- the row is tagged drive_in for the 65 sites you can park at.
